title: Take away the stone — and do not roll it back
english: The stone is only rolled away. The stone on the tomb had to be taken away entirely and not rolled back; the stone on the well only rolled away.
[[“If you believe, you will see the glory of God.” >> Bible:John 11:40]] Whoever has not yet seen the glory is shown not yet to have believed.
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew.

title: Martha’s delay between ‘Take away the stone’ and the act
english: The slowness of taking away the stone over the cave came from the dead man’s sister.

Between [[“Take away the stone” >> Bible:John 11:39]] and [[“So they took away the stone” >> Bible:John 11:41]] Martha’s words hindered: [[“Lord, already he smells, for it is the fourth day.” >> Bible:John 11:39]]
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew.

title: Nothing should stand between command and deed
english: It is good that nothing stand between Jesus’ command and the deed of those commanded.
The one who postpones has a time of disobedience in the delay: [[“Do not put off returning to the Lord.” >> Bible:Sirach 5:7]]
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew.

title: Jesus lifts his eyes — disciples are not below
english: [[He lifted up his eyes and said… >> Bible:John 11:41]] One must carefully watch Jesus’ eyes and their relation to people.
We learn that Jesus’ disciples are not below; therefore the teacher’s eyes are lifted toward them.
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew.

title: Whom it befits to imitate Jesus lifting the eyes
english: To show more clearly whom it already befits to imitate Jesus lifting his eyes upward:
Those among people living in flesh who are worthy and [[do not wage war according to the flesh. >> Bible:2 Corinthians 10:3]]
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew.

title: Father, I thank you that you heard me
english: Jesus lifted his eyes and, still about to pray, was already heard — and instead of petition gave thanks.
[[“Father, I thank you that you have heard me. I knew that you always hear me.” >> Bible:John 11:41-42]]
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew.

title: Because of the crowd standing around
english: [[“But I said this because of the crowd standing around, that they may believe that you sent me.” >> Bible:John 11:42]]
He does not give thanks for his own sake as if unknown to the Father, but because of those standing around.
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew.

title: Lazarus our friend has fallen asleep
english: [[“Lazarus our friend has fallen asleep; but I go to awaken him.” >> Bible:John 11:11]]
Ask whether Jesus fulfilled what follows from “has fallen asleep”; the disciples took it of ordinary sleep.
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew.

title: I am glad for your sake that I was not there
english: [[“I am glad for your sake that I was not there, so that you may believe. But let us go to him.” >> Bible:John 11:15]]
His absence is arranged for greater faith from the raising of the four-day dead.
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew.

title: Thomas: let us also go that we may die with him
english: Thomas called the Twin said to his fellow disciples, [[“Let us also go, that we may die with him.” >> Bible:John 11:16]]
He speaks with a martyr’s love, not yet knowing the power of the resurrection.
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew.

title: I am the resurrection and the life
english: Jesus said to her, [[“I am the resurrection and the life. Whoever believes in me, even if he dies, will live.” >> Bible:John 11:25]]
He does not only promise a future resurrection; being himself the resurrection he already acts.
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew.

title: Do you believe this?
english: [[“And everyone who lives and believes in me will never die. Do you believe this?” >> Bible:John 11:26]]
The question tests Martha and, through her, every believer.
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew.

title: Yes, Lord; I have believed that you are the Christ
english: She said to him, [[“Yes, Lord; I have believed that you are the Christ, the Son of God, who is coming into the world.” >> Bible:John 11:27]]
The confession is good; yet works must also agree with faith concerning the glory of God.
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew.
